definitions.explanation: The supreme governing authority of a state or the ultimate power held by the people in a democratic system. A fundamental concept in political science and international law.

examples.japanese: {国|くに}の{主権|しゅけん}を{守|まも}る。
{日本国憲法|にほんこくけんぽう}では{主権|しゅけん}は{国民|こくみん}にある。
examples.english: Under the Japanese constitution, sovereignty lies with the people.

examples.japanese: {領土|りょうど}{問題|もんだい}は{国家|こっか}の{主権|しゅけん}に{関|かか}わる{重大|じゅうだい}な{問題|もんだい}であり、{簡単|かんたん}には{解決|かいけつ}できない。
examples.english: Territorial issues are serious matters involving national sovereignty and cannot be easily resolved.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {主|しゅ} (main, master) + {権|けん} (right, authority). Central to Japanese civics education. The concept of {国民|こくみん}{主権|しゅけん} (popular sovereignty) is one of the three pillars of the Japanese constitution.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {国民|こくみん}{主権|しゅけん} (popular sovereignty)
- {主権|しゅけん}を{行使|こうし}する (to exercise sovereignty)
- {主権|しゅけん}{国家|こっか} (sovereign state)
- {主権|しゅけん}を{侵害|しんがい}する (to violate sovereignty)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {権力|けんりょく}: power, authority — broader, not limited to nations
- {自治|じち}: self-governance, autonomy — governance at a local level
